sloka: कस्य रूपम् इदम् दृष्ट्वा जांबूनदमय प्रभम् ।नाना रत्नमयम् दिव्यम् न मनो विस्मयम् व्रजेत् ॥३-४३-३०॥
transliteration: kasya rūpam idam dṛṣṭvā jāṁbūnadamaya prabham ।nānā ratnamayam divyam na mano vismayam vrajet ॥3-43-30॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana kings who wield bows in hunting expeditions kill deer in the forest for sport as well as for venison.
